title: Stoichiometry silently accepts unbalanced equations and returns wrong yields
repro_steps: On zuko_qa_t1, /lenses/chem > Structure > Stoichiometry: enter 'H2 + O2 -> H2O' with H2 4 g, O2 40 g. Repeat with 'Fe + O2 -> Fe2O3' (Fe 4 g) and 'C3H8 + O2 -> CO2 + H2O' (C3H8 4 g).
